name: Cafe24
description: Cafe24 Admin API for shops built on Cafe24 in Korea and Japan: orders, items and receivers, shipments with tracking numbers, cancellation, return and exchange claims, products, variants and stock, categories, carriers, customers, product boards and the dashboard. OAuth app per mall.
instructions:
## Cafe24
This connector works with the **Cafe24 Admin API** (`https://<mall_id>.cafe24api.com/api/v2/admin`, version 2026-09-01), for shops built on Cafe24 in Korea and Japan: orders, items, receivers, shipments with tracking numbers, cancellation, return and exchange claims, products, variants and stock, categories, carriers, customers, boards (product questions and reviews) and the dashboard.

**Setup (about 15 minutes)**
1. Sign in at `https://developers.cafe24.com` with a Cafe24 account and add an app (**Apps, App management**). Under the app's development information copy the **Client ID** into `CAFE24_CLIENT_ID` and the **Client Secret** into `CAFE24_CLIENT_SECRET`.
2. Set the app's **Redirect URI** to `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud (or `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself). Cafe24 accepts https addresses with a domain only.
3. Under **Permissions** tick: store read, order read and write, product read and write, category read, shipping read, personal information read, community read and write (the scopes `mall.read_store, mall.read_order, mall.write_order, mall.read_product, mall.write_product, mall.read_category, mall.read_shipping, mall.read_privacy, mall.read_community, mall.write_community`).
4. Enter your mall id (the first part of `<mall_id>.cafe24.com`) in `CAFE24_MALL_ID` and install the connector.
5. Click **Authorize with Provider** on the connector page and sign in as the mall's **representative operator** (대표 운영자): sub-operators get access_denied. An app that has not been through Cafe24's App Store review can be installed on up to 5 malls, which is enough for your own shop.

Tokens: the access token lasts 2 hours and the refresh token 2 weeks; each refresh returns a new refresh token, which the connector stores. Cafe24 allows only 15 token requests per 2 hours per mall, so the connector renews only near expiry. If the connector is idle for more than 2 weeks, authorize again.

**Where to start**: `cafe24_get_dashboard` for today's figures, then `cafe24_list_orders` with start_date, end_date and order_status N20,N21 (to ship), embed items,receivers.

**Orders**: `cafe24_list_orders` (start_date and end_date together, at most 3 months), `cafe24_count_orders`, `cafe24_get_order`, `cafe24_list_order_items`, `cafe24_get_order_receivers`, `cafe24_get_claim` (cancellation, return or exchange by claim code). Status codes: N00 awaiting payment, N10 in progress, N20 preparing, N21 awaiting shipment, N22 on hold, N30 in transit, N40 delivered, N50 purchase confirmed; C cancellation, R return and E exchange codes. Formats: order_id `20260710-0000013`, order_item_code `20260710-0000013-01`, shipping_code `D-20260710-0000013-00`.

**Shipping**: `cafe24_list_carriers` gives the 4-digit carrier codes (0006 CJ Korea Express, 0019 Lotte, 0018 Hanjin, 0083 Sagawa, 0084 Yamato). `cafe24_update_order_status` moves an order to prepare or hold; `cafe24_create_shipment` registers the tracking number (standby or shipping); `cafe24_update_shipment` changes the status to shipped, or corrects the tracking number; `cafe24_list_order_shipments` lists them. Cancelling, returns, exchanges and refunds are not included, because they return money.

**Products and stock**: `cafe24_list_products`, `cafe24_count_products`, `cafe24_get_product`, `cafe24_update_product` (prices, name, codes, summary), `cafe24_list_variants`, `cafe24_update_variant`, `cafe24_get_inventory` and `cafe24_update_inventory` (quantity is the available stock). `cafe24_set_product_display` is switched off at install: F hides the product or takes it off sale. `cafe24_list_categories` lists the categories.

**Customers and boards**: `cafe24_search_customers` reads personal data (permission mall.read_privacy). `cafe24_list_boards` and `cafe24_list_board_articles` (Korean and Japanese stores only) show product questions and reviews with their reply status; `cafe24_add_board_comment` answers publicly. `cafe24_get_store` and `cafe24_list_shops` describe the mall; every tool takes `shop_no` (default 1) for multi-shop malls.

**Paging and limits**: lists take `limit` and `offset` (orders up to 1000 per page and offset 15000, products 100 and 5000, then since_product_no). Cafe24 allows bursts of 40 calls draining at 2 per second per mall (header X-Api-Call-Limit) and 3,000 calls per 10 minutes per token; above that it answers 429. Errors are `error` with `code` and `message`; 422 names the invalid field.

CAFE24_MALL_ID.label: Mall ID
CAFE24_MALL_ID.help: The first part of your Cafe24 address: for myshop.cafe24.com enter myshop.
CAFE24_MALL_ID.patternMessage: Enter only the mall id in lower case, e.g. myshop, without https:// and without .cafe24.com.

CAFE24_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
CAFE24_CLIENT_ID.help: Cafe24 Developers, your app, development information: Client ID.
CAFE24_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the Client ID only, without spaces.

CAFE24_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client Secret
CAFE24_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Cafe24 Developers, your app, development information: Client Secret.
CAFE24_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Client Secret without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Cafe24 refused the access token. Click Authorize with Provider again; the refresh token lasts 2 weeks.
verifyHints.403: The app lacks the permission (scope) for this call, or the shop blocks it. Tick the permission in Cafe24 Developers and authorize again.

404.hint: Cafe24 found no mall, order or product here. Check the mall id and the order id or product number.

verifyHints.rate_limited: Cafe24 allows bursts of 40 calls draining at 2 per second per mall. Wait a few seconds and try again.
verifyHints.access_denied: Only the representative operator of the mall can authorize an app. Sign in with that account.
verifyHints.invalid_scope: A requested scope is not ticked under the app permissions in Cafe24 Developers. Tick all the scopes listed in the setup and authorize again.

unreachable.hint: No Cafe24 mall answers at this mall id. Check the first part of your cafe24.com address.

prerequisites: A Cafe24 mall (Korea or Japan) where you are the representative operator, and a free Cafe24 Developers account to create the app. About 15 minutes.

tools.name: cafe24_get_store
tools.description: The mall: shop_name, mall_id, base and primary domain, company name, country, email, phone, customer service details and mall URL. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_shops
tools.description: The shops of the mall (up to 6, for different languages or currencies): shop_no, default, shop_name, language_code, currency_code, timezone, active and primary domain. Read-only.

tools.name: cafe24_get_dashboard
tools.description: Store dashboard: daily, weekly and monthly sales figures, sold-out product count, new members and recent board posts. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_orders
tools.description: List orders: order_id, order_date, payment_date, paid, canceled, payment_method, payment_amount, currency, member_id, billing_name, shipping_status and amounts; with embed also items (order_item_code, product, option, quantity, status), receivers and buyer. start_date and end_date go together, at most 3 months. Up to 1000 per page, offset up to 15000. Read-only.

start_date.description: Start of the period (send with end_date; at most 3 months per call): YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

end_date.description: End of the period: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

date_type.description: Which date the period applies to: order_date (default), pay_date, shipbegin_date, shipend_date, cancel_date, purchaseconfirmation_date, updatereceiver_date.

order_status.description: Order item status codes, comma-separated: N00 awaiting payment, N10 order in progress, N20 preparing shipment, N21 awaiting shipment, N22 shipment on hold, N30 in transit, N40 delivered, N50 purchase confirmed; C00 cancel requested and other C codes; R00 return requested and other R codes; E00 exchange requested and other E codes.

payment_status.description: F unpaid, M partly paid, T paid, A awaiting deposit, P partly refunded.

product_no.description: Product number contained in the order.

embed.description: Sub-resources to include, comma-separated: items, receivers, buyer, return, cancellation, exchange.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_count_orders
tools.description: Count the orders that match the same filters as cafe24_list_orders: count.count. Read-only.

start_date.description: Start of the period (send with end_date; at most 3 months per call): YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

end_date.description: End of the period: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

date_type.description: Which date the period applies to: order_date (default), pay_date, shipbegin_date, shipend_date, cancel_date, purchaseconfirmation_date, updatereceiver_date.

order_status.description: Order item status codes, comma-separated: N00 awaiting payment, N10 order in progress, N20 preparing shipment, N21 awaiting shipment, N22 shipment on hold, N30 in transit, N40 delivered, N50 purchase confirmed; C00 cancel requested and other C codes; R00 return requested and other R codes; E00 exchange requested and other E codes.

payment_status.description: F unpaid, M partly paid, T paid, A awaiting deposit, P partly refunded.

product_no.description: Product number contained in the order.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_get_order
tools.description: Read one order with its amounts, payment, shipping status and, through embed, items, receivers, buyer and any cancellation, return or exchange. Read-only.

embed.description: Sub-resources, comma-separated: items, receivers, buyer, benefits, coupons, return, cancellation, exchange, refunds.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_order_items
tools.description: Items of one order: order_item_code, variant_code, product_no, product_name, option_value, quantity, product_price, payment_amount, order_status (status code), status_text, shipping_code, tracking_no, shipping company, claim_code and claim reason, shipped and delivered dates. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_get_order_receivers
tools.description: Recipients of one order: name (and furigana for Japanese shops), phone, cellphone, zipcode, address, country, shipping message and shipping_code. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_order_shipments
tools.description: Shipments of one order: shipping_code, tracking_no, shipping_company_code, tracking number update time and the order items with their status. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_get_claim
tools.description: Read one cancellation, return or exchange by its claim code (claim_code of cafe24_list_order_items): reason type and text, items, refund amounts, return tracking and pickup, exchange receiver. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_products
tools.description: List products: product_no, product_code, custom_product_code, product_name, price, retail_price, supply_price, display, selling, sold_out, created_date, updated_date; with embed variants also the variants. Up to 100 per page, offset up to 5000 (beyond that use since_product_no). Read-only.

product_name.description: Product name or part of it.

display.description: T displayed in the store, F hidden.

selling.description: T on sale, F not on sale.

updated_start_date.description: Updated on or after (send with updated_end_date): YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

updated_end_date.description: Updated on or before: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

since_product_no.description: Cursor: only products with a higher product_no (for more than 5000 products; not with offset or sort).

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_count_products
tools.description: Count the products that match the same filters as cafe24_list_products: count.count. Read-only.

product_name.description: Product name or part of it.

display.description: T displayed in the store, F hidden.

selling.description: T on sale, F not on sale.

updated_start_date.description: Updated on or after (send with updated_end_date): YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

updated_end_date.description: Updated on or before: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, store time (KST for Korean malls).

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_get_product
tools.description: Read one product: names, codes, prices, display and selling flags, description, categories, shipping and tax settings; with embed also variants, options, SEO, tags and discount price. Read-only.

embed.description: Sub-resources, comma-separated: variants, memos, hits, seo, tags, options, discountprice.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_variants
tools.description: Variants of one product: variant_code, options (name and value), custom_variant_code, display, selling, additional_amount and, with embed inventories, quantity, safety_inventory and use_inventory. Read-only.

embed.description: inventories: add the stock of each variant.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_get_inventory
tools.description: Stock settings of one variant: use_inventory, important_inventory, inventory_control_type, display_soldout, quantity and safety_inventory. Read-only.

variant_code.description: Variant code, 12 characters, e.g. P000000R000A (variant_code of cafe24_list_variants).

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_categories
tools.description: Product categories: category_no, category_depth (1 to 4), parent_category_no, category_name, full_category_name and use_display. Up to 100 per page. Read-only.

category_name.description: Category name or part of it.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_carriers
tools.description: Carriers set up in the store: carrier_id, shipping_carrier_code (the shipping_company_code for shipments, e.g. 0006 CJ Korea Express, 0019 Lotte, 0084 Yamato), shipping_carrier, tracking URL and default carrier. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers with their personal data (needs the mall.read_privacy permission): member_id, name, email, cellphone, phone, address, group_no, created_date and points. Search by member id, name, phone, email or sign-up date. Up to 1000 per page. Read-only.

search_type.description: customer_info (search_field and keyword), created_date (with start_date and end_date) or member_id.

search_field.description: With customer_info: id, name, hp (mobile), tel or mail.

keyword.description: Search value for search_field, or the member id.

start_date.description: Signed up on or after (with search_type created_date), YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

end_date.description: Signed up on or before, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_boards
tools.description: Boards of the store (Korean and Japanese stores only): board_no, board_type (5 product reviews or Q&A boards, 7 my inquiries, 1 admin notices, 2 general) and board_name. Read-only.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_list_board_articles
tools.description: Posts of one board, such as product questions and reviews: article_no, parent_article_no, product_no, order_id, title, content, writer, member_id, rating, reply_status (N unanswered, P in progress, C answered) and created_date. Period at most one year; up to 100 per page. Read-only.

reply_status.description: N unanswered, P in progress, C answered.

keyword.description: Search text in subject, content or writer.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_create_shipment
tools.description: Register the shipment of an order (or some of its items) with a tracking number and carrier code, as standby (prepared) or shipping (sent). The customer sees the tracking number. Answers the shipment with its shipping_code.

shipping_company_code.description: Carrier code, 4 digits, e.g. 0006 (shipping_carrier_code of cafe24_list_carriers).

status.description: standby (ready, not sent yet) or shipping (handed to the carrier).

order_item_codes.description: Only these order items (order_item_code, e.g. 20260627-0000017-01). Leave out for the whole order.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_update_shipment
tools.description: Update one shipment of an order: either its status (standby, shipping, shipped) or its tracking number and carrier, not both in one call.

status.description: New status: standby, shipping or shipped (delivered).

status_additional_info.description: Extra note for the status change.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_update_order_status
tools.description: Move an order (or some items) in the fulfilment flow: prepare (preparing shipment), prepareproduct (preparing the product), hold or unhold. Shipping itself is done with cafe24_create_shipment.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_update_product
tools.description: Change the price, retail price, supply price, name, own product code or summary description of one product. Fields left out keep their value.

price.description: Selling price in the shop currency.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_update_variant
tools.description: Change the surcharge (additional_amount) or your own code of one variant.

variant_code.description: Variant code, 12 characters, e.g. P000000R000A (variant_code of cafe24_list_variants).

additional_amount.description: Surcharge on the product price for this variant (may be negative).

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_update_inventory
tools.description: Set the stock of one variant: quantity (available stock), safety_inventory, whether stock is managed (use_inventory) and whether it shows as sold out at 0 (display_soldout).

variant_code.description: Variant code, 12 characters, e.g. P000000R000A (variant_code of cafe24_list_variants).

use_inventory.description: T manage stock for this variant, F do not.

display_soldout.description: T show sold out when the stock is 0.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_add_board_comment
tools.description: Post a comment under a board post, for example to answer a product question or a review. The comment is public on the store.

writer.description: Name shown as the writer, up to 100 characters.

password.description: Password of the comment (Cafe24 requires one, up to 20 characters); needed to edit it in the store.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).

tools.name: cafe24_set_product_display
tools.description: Show or hide one product in the store (display) and put it on or off sale (selling). F takes it off sale for customers.

selling.description: T on sale, F not on sale.

shop_no.description: Shop number inside the mall (1 is the default shop; a mall can have up to 6 shops, see cafe24_list_shops).
